name: Bitcurex
rootCause: Bitcurex, a major Polish Bitcoin exchange, suffered a critical security breach in October 2016. Roughly 2,300 BTC (~$1.5 million) were stolen from exchange-managed hot wallets, forcing a shutdown and leading to user asset loss with no clear evidence of recovery. Bitcurex lost control of hot wallet private keys following an external breach, allowing unauthorized withdrawal of exchange-held customer funds. No evidence establishes a specific technical vulnerability or insider involvement.
